items.headline: Three Billy Edwards TD passes lift UNC to 38-21 win over UConn in Belichick's return to New England
items.description: — Billy Edwards threw for three touchdowns and North Carolina scored 21 points off three turnovers as the Tar Heels defeated UConn 38-21 to snap a two-game losing streak in coach Bill Belichick’s return to New England.
